text:
Type: folk embroidered cushion
Use: on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, bohemian, rustic
Materials: tightly woven cotton fabric with colorful stitched embroidery
Colors: dark navy blue ground, red, cobalt blue, mustard yellow, leaf green, cream
Shape: square cushion with a symmetrical folk-art motif, a central blooming flower, round red and blue blossoms, a red bird on top, two leaping deer below, vine border, plump and soft
Feel: lively, cozy, handcrafted, festive
Goes with: dark blue or red textiles, warm wood, cream walls; Scandinavian folk, rustic or bohemian rooms

product.name: RENREPE
product.description: You can easily vary the look because the two sides have different designs.
